steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the RFQ counter-offer option required by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as an RFQ with entire-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Confirm the product variant shown in the case data.
Set the requested delivery location.

args.goal: open the Schedule Event drawer, set the bidding duration to 15 Mins, set Evaluation time to 30 minutes, save the schedule, and stop on the create screen showing the saved schedule

steps.note: Configure and commit both the bidding and evaluation durations, including the evaluation setting not exposed by a dedicated schedule step.
Add one QA test vendor so the event can be published and bid on.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Assert that publication reached a real event page.
Have the invited vendor submit a bid so the event can enter evaluation after bidding ends.
Assert that the vendor bid was accepted.
End bidding so the configured evaluation window begins.

args.goal: on the event after bidding ends, verify that the evaluation state is shown with a running evaluation countdown and verify that counter-offer and Reject Bid controls are available and can be used during the evaluation window

steps.note: Exercise the evaluation-window behavior and the case's expected actions that have no single dedicated assertion step.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's current status.
View the live events where an event in evaluation is listed.
Assert that the event transitioned into evaluation.
